title: Keeping the Ball Rolling: Fullerene-like Molecular Clusters
claim: An icosahedral inner shell enclosed by a fullerene-like outer shell recurs across several chemically different multishell clusters.
explanation: The review identifies this arrangement in the Pd-based clusters and in main-group Al and Ga systems, and also points to an As dodecahedron enclosing a Ni icosahedron.
scope: Selected metal-bonded and onion-like clusters discussed in Sections 2.1–2.2.
caveats: A spherical multishell core is not necessarily fullerene-like; the review explicitly distinguishes these descriptions for several main-group examples.
